title: Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Correction of Errors
summary: Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Correction of Errors is part of the Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE).
description: This standard is part of the ASBE framework issued by the Chinese Ministry of Finance. It provides guidance on Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Correction of Errors.
